question: Should new standard StepFun and Step Plan setups now default to Step 3.7 Flash, replacing the Step 3.5 default deliberately retained when the model was added?
rationale: Upstream supports Step 3.7 on both products and the implementation is narrow, but repository history shows that availability and default selection were treated as separate intentional choices; automation cannot choose that provider product policy.

options.title: Adopt Step 3.7 default
options.body: Approve the shared default after the contributor supplies redacted fresh-onboarding proof for both products and confirms explicit existing selections remain preserved.

options.title: Keep Step 3.5 default
options.body: Leave Step 3.7 selectable without changing new-setup behavior if maintainers prefer the existing stability policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt Step 3.7 default
recommendation.body: Approve the shared default after the contributor supplies redacted fresh-onboarding proof for both products and confirms explicit existing selections remain preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: The current default line and the most recent analogous provider-default policy work are tied to this current-main contributor.
